reviewers.role: An experienced lexicographer and teacher of Chinese who labels each word with topics from the list, using its CC-CEDICT senses and the topic of its OpenMoji picture as a hint.
A native Mandarin speaker from Beijing who has taught Chinese to adult learners for fifteen years and prepares students for the HSK.
A native Mandarin speaker from Shanghai who teaches Chinese at a university language centre and writes theme-based course units for beginners and intermediate learners.
A native Mandarin speaker who heads a Chinese-as-a-foreign-language department and designs curricula; decides where the two teachers disagree and checks every sense entry the decision kept.

learners also meet 包 as 'bag' early, which is taught with accessories | At HSK 1-2, learners meet 包 mainly as the noun 'bag' (书包, 钱包, 包包), which belongs with accessories; the verb 'wrap' stays in actions.

次 is mainly the counter for times (frequency), as in 这次/下次; it is not an order word for learners | Teacher A is right: learners meet 次 as the counter for occurrences (这次, 下次, 三次), and frequency belongs to time. The order sense 'second/next' is marginal at this level.

on its own 名 is met as the counter for people (一名学生) and as a ranking word (第一名); 'name' comes through 名字, and 'people' is a loose fit | Teacher A is right: on its own, 名 is met as the counter for people (一名学生) and in rankings (第一名). 'Name' is learned through 名字, and 'people' is only a loose fit.
beginners learn 跳舞 in the free-time/hobbies unit (我喜欢跳舞); arts is secondary | Beginner courses teach 跳舞 in the free-time and hobbies unit (我喜欢跳舞), so hobbies should come first.

Learners meet 位 as the polite classifier for people (一位老师). The 'position/seat' sense is 位置/座位 and is not taught in the direction unit. | Learners meet 位 as the polite classifier for people (几位?); 'position' belongs to 位置, not this word
Usually learned as the public washroom (请问洗手间在哪儿) in town, restaurants and malls. The routine link is loose. | Usually taught as a public facility (请问洗手间在哪儿); routine is a loose link

Not a degree or negation adverb; it is taught mainly for doing things with others (我们一起去吧) | Taught mainly for doing things with others (我们一起去吧); it is a common adverb but not a degree or negation word, so function comes second.

Typically taught in the school unit (上课迟到) as well as with time | Being late is about time, and it is a staple of the classroom unit (上课迟到).

A story is narrative or literature. The language unit is a loose fit. | 故事 is taught with stories and literature; it is not a language-structure word, so 'language' is dropped.

老 is mainly about age and the familiar prefix for people (老王), so the age-group unit comes first | 老 is first about age groups and the familiar prefix for people (老王, 老人). Describing someone as old goes to character as a secondary topic.
taught in the school/university unit; travel is only a loose association | An international student belongs in the school/university unit; the link to travel is too loose to justify a second unit.
taught first in asking-directions-in-town unit (在路口左转); city should lead | Learners first meet 路口 when asking directions in town (在路口左转), so city leads and traffic is secondary.

毛 as the colloquial money unit (五毛钱) is a core beginner use and belongs in the money unit | Hair, fur and feathers fit body and animals, and 毛 as the money unit (五毛钱) is a core beginner use taught with prices.

the 'wife' reading nǚren is colloquial and rare for learners; no sense entry needed | The 'wife' reading nǚren is colloquial and rarely met at this level, so it needs no sense entry; 'woman' fits people.

learners first meet 拍照 when sightseeing; the travel unit comes first | beginners learn 拍照 in the sightseeing/travel unit; photography as art is secondary | Beginners learn 拍照 while sightseeing, then as a pastime; photography as an art comes last.
'other' is a pronoun-like function word, not a quantity or counting word | 其他 works like a pronoun or determiner meaning 'other', not a counting or quantity word.
'market' survives only in compounds (超市, 市场); a learner meets 市 alone as city or municipality | learners meet 市 as city/municipality; the market sense is literary or only in compounds like 超市
a profession word; it is taught first in the jobs unit | 司机 is taught first as a profession in the jobs unit and is reused in the transport unit.

learners meet standalone 行 mostly as 'OK, capable' (行, 不行); walking is mostly in compounds | Learners meet standalone 行 mostly as 'OK / capable' (行, 不行); 'to walk' or 'travel' appears mainly in compounds.
Learners mainly meet 选 as choosing; 'elect' is a minor sense and does not justify a society unit. | Learners mainly meet 选 as choosing; 'elect' is a minor sense that doesn't justify a society unit.

Learners meet 越 in 越来越 and 越…越…; 'climb over' is rare at this level | At this level 越 appears almost only in 越来越 and 越…越…; 'climb over' is rare.
At HSK level 张 is the classifier for flat things; 'to open/spread' is marginal | 张 is taught as the classifier for flat objects; 'open/spread' is marginal for learners.
骑自行车 is taught in the transport unit; cycling as a sport is only a loose association. | 骑自行车 is taught in the transport unit; cycling as a sport is only a loose association.

Sense 1 is mostly 'surface/show/model'; the maternal-cousin meaning lives only in compounds like 表哥, so a family entry is misleading | 表 is learned as a watch, worn as an accessory; the maternal-cousin sense lives only in compounds like 表哥, so no family entry.
部 is a common HSK classifier for films and phones (一部电影, 一部手机) | 部 means department, and it is also a common HSK classifier for films and phones (一部电影).

Learners mostly meet 材料 as documents or materials to prepare for work and study; the natural-world link is loose | Learners meet 材料 mostly as documents or materials prepared for work and study; the natural-world link is loose.
